title: release r16: 50-group synonyms, typo tolerance, 108 golden queries
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- Synonym dictionary expanded 12 -> 50 groups (calibrated against real searchText coverage).
- Typo tolerance: single-character wildcard recall as weakest tier (灭活器→灭火器 etc.).
- Golden query suite: 108 cases replayed through the real search code in node tests (synonym/segmentation/typo/keyword/stdNumber/law/precision-miss).
- New r16 bundle (628 hazards / 173 laws, releaseHash 4f6610fa…); all suites green: node 19, python 20+135, v4 regression 20/20.
